Evaluated and improved the system for factual accuracy and completeness using metrics like BLEU and ROUGE, enabling faster access to compliance information.

LLM Fine-Tuning for SOP Automation • Fine-tuned LLaMA and GPT models using QLoRA on a vast corpus of internal pharmaceutical documents to automate SOP summarization, compliance checks. • Captured pharma nuances, cutting manual review & documentation effort by 40%.

Utilized BERTopic for topical modeling, executed sentiment analysis models on social media data, providing valuable market

to identify irregularities in the supply, demand, BOM, recipe master data Implemented a dynamic pricing engine using price elasticity modeling and linear programming (SciPy), delivering a 5-10% margin uplift.

Led the digital transformation strategy, creating a manufacturing ecosystem driven by AI and Industry 4.0 for India and North America.

Deployed predictive maintenance models (SVM, ANN, Random Forest) that reduced monthly maintenance expenditure by 50% and improved MTBF by 20%.

Enhanced product robustness by implementing DMAIC methodology and ML models (Random Forest, GBM), reducing batch failures by 30%

Designed and led the ML pipeline for Yield Improvement, increasing the yield of the top 20 SKUs to 98% and delivering annual savings of ₹5.6 Cr.

Algorithm for a product mix of 200+ SKUs, reducing logistics costs by 22%.

Developed power consumption time series model (SARIMAX, ARIMA) for predicting bid quantity from IEX (0.3Cr INR)
